name: helm
description: Helm — a from-scratch redesign of FACE Prep's internal Authoring Portal (institutions, batches, question bank, assessments, LMS, delivery). Standalone pitch project, not affiliated software of FACE Prep's real system — grounded in its real schema, all content simulated.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "node server.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
